name: Cá song
summary: Cá song is one of the nine foods the island’s special-zone list tells you to eat, sold by the kilogram on the harbor streets and sometimes priced above and below 2 kg. Cá song vang, cá song hoa, and cá song vang lai hổ are listed as their own fish.
howToEat: Pick it by weight and have the kitchen cook it. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, the two seafood streets of Cát Bà town.
